{{Top|leg}}
'''Rebel Routers''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] assigned to [[Draenell's Point]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were each armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and two [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]], and carried a [[Medium repeating blaster/Legends|medium repeating blaster]]. They were held in reserve during the defense of [[agricultural loading platform XT-21s]] during the [[Battle of Bissillirus]], and acted as Imperial reinforcements during the engagement.
